settings.question: Where do you ship to?
settings.answer: We currently ship to customers in Australia only.

settings.question: How much does shipping cost?
settings.answer: Shipping is free and tracked on every order. Delivery costs are already included in the product price, so there are no additional shipping charges at checkout unless clearly stated otherwise.

settings.question: How long will my order take to arrive?
settings.answer: Orders are processed within 1–3 business days, then shipping usually takes 7–12 business days. Estimated total delivery time is 8–15 business days. Delivery times are estimates and are not guaranteed.

settings.question: When is my order processed?
settings.answer: Orders are processed Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays. Orders placed before 17:00 (EST) are typically processed the same day; orders placed after this time are processed on the following business day.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order has been dispatched, you’ll receive a shipping confirmation email with your tracking number and courier details. You can track your order at any time using our Track Order page.

settings.question: Why isn’t my tracking updating yet?
settings.answer: Please allow up to 24 hours for tracking updates to appear after dispatch.

settings.question: Which carriers do you use?
settings.answer: Deliveries within Australia are handled by Australia Post or equivalent trusted couriers such as Aramex or CouriersPlease. Orders may be fulfilled from our international fulfilment centres, and all shipments include full tracking from dispatch to delivery.

settings.question: Can I cancel my order?
settings.answer: Orders can be cancelled before they are shipped. Contact us in time and we’ll refund you in full to your original payment method. Once your parcel is on its way, cancellation is no longer possible, so please reach out to our customer support team as soon as you can.

settings.question: What is your returns policy?
settings.answer: You can request a return within 30 days of receiving your order. Items must be unused, in their original condition, and returned with original packaging, accessories and documentation.

settings.question: How do I request a return?
settings.answer: Email support@heitz.shop with your order number, the reason for the request, and photos or videos if applicable. Our support team will review your request, provide return instructions and the return address. All returns must be sent using a trackable shipping service.

settings.question: Who pays for return shipping?
settings.answer: For change-of-mind returns, return shipping costs are your responsibility and original shipping costs are non-refundable. If you received the wrong product or a damaged or faulty item, we’ll cover return shipping or provide a prepaid return label, with no restocking fee.

settings.question: When will I get my refund?
settings.answer: Refunds are processed within 14 days of receiving the returned item or proof of return, and are issued to the original payment method unless store credit is requested. Gift cards and items damaged or altered by the customer can’t be returned. We don’t offer direct exchanges — please return the original item for a refund or store credit and place a new order.

settings.question: My order arrived damaged or faulty. What should I do?
settings.answer: Please report it as soon as possible and no later than 30 days after delivery, with clear photos of the item and packaging. After review, we’ll arrange a replacement or full refund.

settings.question: Is there a warranty?
settings.answer: All products come with a 1-year warranty covering manufacturing defects from the date your order is delivered. If you believe your product has a defect, contact us at support@heitz.shop with your order number and clear photos or videos showing the issue.

settings.question: What does the warranty not cover?
settings.answer: The warranty doesn’t cover damage caused by incorrect installation, misuse, accidental damage, normal wear and tear, modifications, power surges, or repairs carried out by an unauthorised third party.

settings.question: I received the wrong product. What happens next?
settings.answer: Notify us within 30 days of delivery. We’ll cover return shipping or provide a prepaid return label, there’s no restocking fee, and after inspection you can choose a replacement or a full refund.

settings.question: What can cause a delivery delay?
settings.answer: Delays can occur due to circumstances outside our control, such as customs processing, courier delays or peak-demand periods. Please make sure your shipping address is entered correctly at checkout — we’re not responsible for delays, losses or failed deliveries caused by incorrect or incomplete addresses.

settings.question: My order hasn’t arrived. When should I contact you?
settings.answer: If your order hasn’t arrived within 10 business days after the estimated delivery window, please contact us at support@heitz.shop and we’ll investigate with the courier.

settings.question: What if my parcel is lost?
settings.answer: Once the courier confirms a package as lost, you can choose between a replacement or a full refund to your original payment method.

settings.question: How can I contact customer support?
settings.answer: Email support@heitz.shop or call +1 (917) 261-2026, Monday to Friday, 09:00–17:00 (EST). We aim to respond within 12–24 hours.
